{{Top|leg|canon=Blaster fight}}
{{Youmay|the equivalent term of "firefight"|the book ''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''}}
[[File:OverMyDeadBody_2017Q4_TournamentKit_CorePrizeCard.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] caught in a lightfight]]
{{Quote|Never done that before.''"<br />"''Blunder into a lightfight or spend time in a bacta tank?''"<br />"''Neither. I didn't think I was blundering&hellip;|[[Gavin Darklighter]] and Corran Horn|<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Lightfight''',<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron" /> also '''firefight'''<ref name= "Lost Legacy">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref> or '''blaster fight''', was a popular colloquialism in use during the years of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] that referred to a fight between combatants armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-style weaponry. [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] used the term often, while other members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] were also known to speak of it.
